notes: Fixes calls and voice notes on the phone. Android grants the microphone at the moment you use it, and Vaultline never asked — so calls failed, and then explained the failure by telling you that you needed a secure https connection, which is advice for a browser and means nothing on a phone. It now asks, and when something is refused it points at your phone's own permission screen instead. Tapping the microphone to record used to do nothing at all if the permission had been refused once; it now says so. The Vault also opens with a number pad, behind a vault door whose dial turns while the lock is being worked, and opens about twice as fast — an older vault speeds itself up the first time you open it. And updates install themselves from inside the app now, with a progress figure, deleting the downloaded file the next time you open Vaultline rather than leaving 75 MB in your Downloads folder. The first time, Android will ask you to allow Vaultline to install apps; it used to ask that of your browser.
